Todaytec CRM — Sales User Manual3
01Section
Todaytec CRM · Sales

Getting started

Todaytec CRM is where you keep your customers, projects, quotations and POs in one place.

Sign in

  1. 1
    Open the CRM link in your browser.
  2. 2
    Type your work Email and Password.
  3. 3
    Leave Remember me ticked on your own computer.
  4. 4
    Click Sign in.

After 10 wrong passwords, the CRM locks sign-in for 15 minutes.

Todaytec CRM — Sales User Manual4
01Getting started

Forgot your password

  1. 1
    On the sign-in screen, click Forgot password?.
  2. 2
    Type your email and click Send reset link.
  3. 3
    Open the email and click the link. It works for 30 minutes.
  4. 4
    Type it in New password and Confirm password, then click Update password.
  5. 5
    Click Go to sign in and sign in with the new password.

The top bar

  • Date range (left): every page opens on This month. Click it to pick another period.
  • Country: shows All countries when you cover more than one market. Pick one market to narrow every page.
  • Language: switch between EN, VI and TH.
  • Your name: click it for View profile and Sign out.

Change the date range

  1. 1
    Click the date button on the left of the top bar.
  2. 2
    Pick a preset, such as Last month or Year to date.
  3. 3
    Or click a start day and an end day on the calendar.
  4. 4
    Optional: choose a period in Compare to.
  5. 5
    Click Apply.
Todaytec CRM — Sales User Manual5
01Getting started

Update your profile

  1. 1
    Click your name, then View profile.
  2. 2
    In My profile, change your name, phone or photo (Upload photo).
  3. 3
    Click Save.

The sidebar

  • The sidebar lists only the modules you have access to.
  • Indented items belong to the item above them. For example, Pipelines, Samples and Quotations sit under Projects.
  • Clicking a module in the sidebar always brings you back to its list.
  • Click ‹ at the top to hide the sidebar. Click › to show it again.
Tips
  • The date range and country apply to every page at once.
  • Your language choice stays on this browser.
Todaytec CRM — Sales User Manual6
02Section
Todaytec CRM · Sales

Overview

Overview is your dashboard: it shows how your customers, projects and sales are doing for the chosen period.

Read your numbers

  1. 1
    Set the period with the date range in the top bar.
  2. 2
    Read the top counters: Customers, In pipeline, Active projects, Samples, Quotations and PO conversion.
  3. 3
    Check the value cards: Total value, PO value, Project value and Forecast value.
  4. 4
    Each value card shows MTD, QTD and YTD, with the change against the last period.

Drill into the details

  1. 1
    Click an MTD, QTD or YTD figure on PO value to open those POs in PO List.
  2. 2
    Scroll to Sales breakdown to see your sales by company, sales rep, product and customer type.
  3. 3
    Type in a table’s search box to find one company or product.
  4. 4
    In Re-order radar, click View all → to open Retention.
  5. 5
    In Running projects, click a project to open it.
Todaytec CRM — Sales User Manual7
02Overview
Tips
  • Upcoming meetings lists the meetings you logged on customer profiles.
  • Numbers only include the customers you are allowed to see.
Todaytec CRM — Sales User Manual8
03Section
Todaytec CRM · Sales

Customers

Customers holds every company you sell to, with its contacts, status and history.

Find a customer

  1. 1
    Click Customers in the sidebar.
  2. 2
    Type a company name, phone, email, Business ID or PO number in the search box.
  3. 3
    Narrow the list with Type, Lead source, Pipeline or Has (Has projects / Has PO).
  4. 4
    Use Sort by to order the list.

Group by Name Code is on by default. Companies with the same Name Code show as one row.

  • Click the row or its arrow to see the companies under it.
  • Click View detail → to open the customer profile.
  • Click Group by Name Code again to see one row per company.

Add a customer

  1. 1
    Click Add customer.
  2. 2
    Type the Company name. The CRM suggests a Name Code in Short name.
  3. 3
    Keep the suggestion, pick an existing code to join that group, or type a new one.
  4. 4
    Fill Country, Type and Phone. They are required.
  5. 5
    Add the Business ID if you have it. The hint shows the right length per country.
Todaytec CRM — Sales User Manual9
03Customers
  1. 6
    Click Create customer.

The CRM checks for duplicates while you type.

  • Similar records found: check the list, then create the customer if it is really new.
  • Exact match found (same name, Business ID, phone or email): you cannot create it. Click Open → to use the existing record.

Work on a customer profile

  1. 1
    Open the customer from the list.
  2. 2
    Pick a new status in Update status.
  3. 3
    The customer moves to the matching pipeline stage. For example, Quotation / Quote moves it to Warm Lead.
Todaytec CRM — Sales User Manual10
03Customers

The profile also shows the customer’s companies, contacts, projects, POs, samples, quotations and retention.

  • Click New project or New PO on the profile to start one for this customer.
  • Click Edit at the top right to change the customer details.

Log contacts and set the next action

  1. 1
    Scroll down to Interaction timeline.
  2. 2
    Pick Note, Call, Meeting or File.
  3. 3
    For a call, choose the outcome, such as Connected or No answer.
  4. 4
    For a meeting, choose the date and time.
  5. 5
    Type what happened and click Log it.
  6. 6
    Fill Next action date and Next action note. They save when you click outside the box.
Tips
  • Meetings you log appear in Upcoming meetings on Overview.
  • A No contact in 14+ days flag means it is time to call this lead.
  • Status changes are logged in the timeline automatically.
Todaytec CRM — Sales User Manual11
04Section
Todaytec CRM · Sales

Pipelines

Pipelines shows your projects as cards on a board, one column per stage.

See where your deals are

  1. 1
    Click Pipelines in the sidebar.
  2. 2
    Read the columns from left to right: Proposal, Sample, Quotation, PO, Won and Lost.
  3. 3
    The number on each column is how many cards it holds.
  4. 4
    Type a project or company name in the search box to find one card.
  5. 5
    Click List to see the same projects as tables. Click Board to go back.

Move a project to the next stage

  1. 1
    Drag the project card to its new column.
  2. 2
    Drop it. The project’s stage changes at once.
  3. 3
    Click a project card to open the project.
Todaytec CRM — Sales User Manual12
04Pipelines
Tips
  • Cards tagged SAMPLES and QUOTATIONS come from the Samples and Quotations modules. You cannot drag them. Clicking them opens the customer.
  • Moving a card needs Edit access on Pipelines.
  • The board follows the date range in the top bar. Widen it if a project is missing.
Todaytec CRM — Sales User Manual13
05Section
Todaytec CRM · Sales

Projects

Projects tracks each sales opportunity with a customer, from the first proposal to the PO.

Create a project

  1. 1
    Click Projects in the sidebar, then New Project.
  2. 2
    Pick the Customer, or choose ➕ New customer and type its name.
  3. 3
    Type the Project name.
  4. 4
    Pick the Project type: New project, Resupply or Conversion.
  5. 5
    Under Proposed product · SKU, type a product code and pick it from the list. Add the quantity.
  6. 6
    Fill what you know: Expected close, Potential, Current supplier, Win probability (%).
  7. 7
    Click Create project.
Todaytec CRM — Sales User Manual14
05Projects

Ink type fills itself in from the products you pick.

Move a project forward

  1. 1
    Open the project from the list.
  2. 2
    Pick the new Stage: Proposal, Sample, Quotation, PO, Won or Lost.
  3. 3
    The change is saved and logged on the customer’s timeline.
  4. 4
    Click Edit to change other details.

Find a project

  1. 1
    Type a company name or Business ID in the search box.
  2. 2
    Filter by Stage.
  3. 3
    Click the customer name to open the customer instead of the project.
Tips
  • When a project closes, fill Project result in the project form.
  • Projects also show on the customer profile. You can start one there with New project.
Todaytec CRM — Sales User Manual15
06Section
Todaytec CRM · Sales

Samples

Samples tracks the test rolls you send to customers and what they thought of them.

Log a sample you sent

  1. 1
    Click Samples in the sidebar, then New sample.
  2. 2
    Pick the customer and, if there is one, the linked project.
  3. 3
    Add the product code and quantity.
  4. 4
    Fill Sent date, Courier and Tracking no..
  5. 5
    Check the Follow-up date. It is set to 14 days after the sent date.
  6. 6
    Click New sample.
Todaytec CRM — Sales User Manual16
06Samples

Record the customer’s feedback

  1. 1
    Open the sample from the list.
  2. 2
    In Test status, pick Passed, Failed, Testing or No feedback yet.
  3. 3
    Fill Feedback date and Feedback note.
  4. 4
    Pick the project in Link to project if it is not linked yet.
  5. 5
    Click Save & link project.

Follow up on time

  1. 1
    Check the card Today’s task: sample follow-up calls at the top of the page.
  2. 2
    Call each customer on the list and record the feedback.
  3. 3
    Use Test status or Advanced filters to see only the samples you need.
Tips
  • Linking a sample moves the project to the Sample stage.
  • The counters at the top show how many samples are testing, passed, failed or without feedback.
Todaytec CRM — Sales User Manual17
07Section
Todaytec CRM · Sales

Quotations

Quotations is where you price a deal, track its status and send the quote to your customer.

Create a quotation

  1. 1
    Click Quotations in the sidebar, then New quotation.
  2. 2
    Pick the Customer, or choose ➕ New customer.
  3. 3
    Optional: pick the project in Link to project.
  4. 4
    Check Quote date, Valid until and Payment terms.
  5. 5
    Under Line items, type a product code and pick it from the list.
  6. 6
    Pick the Structure code, then type the Qty (rolls) and the Unit price per m².
  7. 7
    Click + Add product (SKU) for more lines.
  8. 8
    Click New quotation to save.

The Roll price and Line total are worked out for you. You can type a roll price instead.

Open and update a quotation

  1. 1
    In the list, click the quotation row or the customer name. Both open the quotation detail.
  2. 2
    Change the Status: Draft, Sent, Negotiating, Won or Lost.
  3. 3
    Click Edit on Line items to change products or prices.
  4. 4
    Pick a project under Link to project and click Save & link project.
Todaytec CRM — Sales User Manual18
07Quotations

A customer with several quotations shows as one row. Click it to see them all.

Send the quotation

  1. 1
    On the quotation detail, click Send quotation.
  2. 2
    Under Seller (company), check the Country.
  3. 3
    If you see Company info: first-time setup, fill in your company details once.
  4. 4
    Click Save company info. From then on they are fixed for that country.
  5. 5
    Check Customer & terms, such as Attend and Term of payment.
  6. 6
    Under Currency, pick the Quote currency and check the USD rate.
  7. 7
    Under Products, adjust the MOQ, the unit price or the product note if needed.
  8. 8
    Check the Preview on the right.
Todaytec CRM — Sales User Manual19
07Quotations

Download or email it

  1. 1
    Pick the file type at the top: Excel + PDF, Excel or PDF.
  2. 2
    Click Download to save the files on your computer.
  3. 3
    Or click Email to your address. The files come to your own inbox.
  4. 4
    Forward that email to the customer.
Tips
  • Download and email stay disabled until the seller company is saved for that country.
  • Only an admin can change the seller company once it is saved. Ask your admin if it is wrong.
  • Your changes on Send quotation are kept for the next time you send this quote.
  • When a quote is Won, create the PO from it. See PO List.

PO List

PO List records every purchase order your customers place, so sales and targets stay up to date.

Find a PO

  1. 1
    Click PO List in the sidebar.
  2. 2
    Set the period with the date range in the top bar.
  3. 3
    Type a company name, PO number or Business ID in the search box. Search covers all dates.
  4. 4
    Click the arrow on a customer row to see its POs.
Todaytec CRM — Sales User Manual21
08PO List
  1. 5
    Click View detail → to open one PO. Click Customer 360° → to open the customer.

Create a PO from a won quotation

  1. 1
    Open the quotation and set its Status to Won.
  2. 2
    In the green box Create PO from this quote, click New PO.
  3. 3
    The New PO form opens with the customer, currency, first product line and Quotation reference filled in.
  4. 4
    Check the Structure code on each line and pick it if it is empty.
  5. 5
    Add any other lines from the quotation with + Add product (SKU).
  6. 6
    Type the PO number and check the Sales date.
  7. 7
    Click New PO to save.
Todaytec CRM — Sales User Manual22
08PO List

Create a PO without a quotation

  1. 1
    Click New PO.
  2. 2
    Pick the Customer, Customer group and PIC.
  3. 3
    Add the products, quantities and prices.
  4. 4
    Type the PO number. Add the Invoice No. if you have it.
  5. 5
    Under Attachments (PO proof), upload the customer’s PO file or photo.
  6. 6
    Click New PO.
Tips
  • Only the first line of a quotation is copied into the PO. Add the other lines yourself.
  • The Customer group you pick also changes the customer’s group in the CRM.
  • Order type (New or Repeat) is set for you from the customer’s PO history.

09Section
Todaytec CRM · Sales

Retention

Retention warns you which customers are late with their next order, so you can call them before they leave.

Find customers who need a call

  1. 1
    Click Retention in the sidebar.
  2. 2
    Click 🔴 At risk or 🟡 Watch to see only those customers.
  3. 3
    Or click a counter card, such as At risk, to filter the list. Click it again to clear.
  4. 4
    Use Search customer… to find one company.

The health colours mean:

  • 🟢 Healthy: ordering on schedule and near or above target.
  • 🟡 Watch: the order is overdue or below target.
  • 🔴 At risk: well overdue and well below target.
Todaytec CRM — Sales User Manual24
09Retention

See what a customer buys

  1. 1
    Click the customer row.
  2. 2
    Read Total PO amount, Annual target, YTD actual and % YTD.
  3. 3
    Check each Structure code: its Last order, Completion and Health.
  4. 4
    Click View detail → to open the customer profile.

Leave a note

  1. 1
    In the opened customer row, click + Add a note… next to a product.
  2. 2
    Type what you agreed with the customer.
  3. 3
    Press Enter or click Save.
Tips
  • Health is worked out from the customer’s PO history and monthly targets.
  • Your note is also copied to the customer’s activity log.
  • Click Reset all to clear every filter.

Targets & Forecast

Targets holds your sales targets (KPI). Sales Forecast predicts next months' orders per customer and product.

Check your targets

  1. 1
    Click Targets in the sidebar.
  2. 2
    Pick the Year and the currency.
  3. 3
    Input by PIC shows the monthly targets per sales rep and customer type group.
  4. 4
    By customer shows the plan per customer and product. Click the arrow on a customer to see its items.
  5. 5
    Tracking compares target and actual: MTD Tracking, Previous month (Act) and YTD Tracking.
Todaytec CRM — Sales User Manual26
10Targets & Forecast

Enter a target

  1. 1
    Open Input by PIC or By customer.
  2. 2
    Click a month cell.
  3. 3
    Type the amount and press Enter.

You need Edit access on Targets to type in the cells. Actuals come from PO List.

Fill in your forecast

  1. 1
    Click Sales Forecast in the sidebar.
  2. 2
    Each customer shows the products it bought, with FC (forecast) and ACTUAL rows per month.
  3. 3
    Type the forecast quantity in the FC cell for the current or a future month. The value fills in from the list price.
  4. 4
    Add a note in Notes if needed.
  5. 5
    Set Status to Submitted when the numbers are final.

Add a customer or a product to the forecast

  1. 1
    Click Add customer to forecast a customer that has no PO yet.
  2. 2
    Click + Add code on a customer row to add another product.
Todaytec CRM — Sales User Manual27
10Targets & Forecast
  1. 3
    Pick from Codes already bought or Never bought.
Tips
  • Greyed numbers in the FC cells are only suggestions: the latest actual × 35%.
  • Total forecast (month) counts only rows set to Submitted or Locked.
  • A Locked forecast can no longer be edited.

Products

Products is the price list: every ribbon code with its grade, size and price for each country.

Look up a product or price

  1. 1
    Click Products in the sidebar.
  2. 2
    Pick the market in the top bar. The list and currency follow it.
  3. 3
    Type a code, name or structure code in Search products….
  4. 4
    Click the arrow on a product code to see its variants.
  5. 5
    Read the Unit price (per m²), Roll price and Size (mm × m).
Todaytec CRM — Sales User Manual29
11Products

Add or change a product

  1. 1
    Click Add product, or Edit on a variant row.
  2. 2
    Fill Commercial name, Product code, Grade and Country.
  3. 3
    Fill the Structure code, Width (mm) and Length (m). The m² per roll fills in.
  4. 4
    Type the Unit price and pick the Currency. The roll price is worked out.
  5. 5
    Click Save.
Tips
  • Quotations, projects and POs take their product list and prices from here.
  • Pick another currency in the toolbar to see prices converted.
  • A product used by a PO cannot be deleted.

Todaytec CRM · Sales

Access & FAQ

Your access level decides what you can see and do in each module of the CRM.

What the access levels allow

Your admin sets one level per module for your role.

LevelWhat you can do
—The module is hidden from your sidebar.
ViewOpen and read the module, and use Export.
EditEverything in View, plus create and edit records.
AdminEverything in Edit, plus delete, Import Excel and maintenance actions.
Todaytec CRM — Sales User Manual31
12Access & FAQ

Your Data scope decides whose records you see:

  • Own customers: only your own customers and their records.
  • Whole country: every customer in your country.
  • All: every record, in every country.

FAQ

QWhy can’t I see a button?

Buttons you are not allowed to use are hidden. For example, Import Excel and Delete need Admin. New … buttons need Edit. Some fields show but are greyed out, like a status you can only read.

QWhy is a customer or PO missing?

  1. 1
    Check the date range in the top bar. Try All time.
  2. 2
    Check the country in the top bar. Try All countries.
  3. 3
    Clear the search box and filters.
  4. 4
    If it is still missing, it may belong to another sales rep. Ask your manager.

QWhat is the More (⋯) button?

It holds admin actions, such as deleting many records at once. It only shows if your level allows them.

QHow do I reset my password?

  1. 1
    On the sign-in screen, click Forgot password?.
  2. 2
    Type your email and click Send reset link.
  3. 3
    Open the link in the email within 30 minutes and set a new password.

QI forgot my password and the email does not arrive.

Check your spam folder. Then ask your admin to set a new password for you.

QWho do I ask?

  • Access, roles and passwords: your CRM admin.
  • Which customers are yours: your sales manager.
  • Wrong seller company details on a quotation: your CRM admin.
